title: Objectives Neighborhood of the Learning Graph
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Learning Graph
Concept Dependency
Learning Objectives
Bloom's Taxonomy
description: A vis-network explorer of the 26 OBJ concepts of the book's learning graph and their direct prerequisites and dependents (57 concepts, 69 edges), with green/orange highlighting, Concept Impact Scores, a transitive-dependents toggle and a Check me quiz on prerequisites.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers and learning-technology developers

educational.topic: Prerequisites and dependents in a learning graph
learningObjectives: Differentiate the prerequisites of a concept from its dependents in a neighborhood of the learning graph.
Explain why a concept with many dependents deserves more careful teaching.

accessibility.textAlternative: Information panel lists the definition, score, prerequisites and dependents of the selected concept

equations: Concept Impact Score = 1 + sum of the scores of the concept's direct dependents
assumptions: Only edges that touch an OBJ concept are shown, so outside concepts show only their links to OBJ concepts.

pedagogical.interactionPattern: Network explorer with highlight and quiz mode
keyQuestions: Which way do the arrows point, and what does that tell you about teaching order?
Why does a weakness in Concept or Learning Objective affect more of the book than a weakness in Learning Outcome?
commonMisconceptions: Arrows point from prerequisite to dependent.
A concept's dependents are also its prerequisites.
All concepts deserve equal teaching time regardless of how much depends on them.
assessmentOpportunities: Check me rounds scored as fully correct attempts.
Written explanation comparing the transitive dependents of a high-score and a low-score concept.
